# HydraFlow Line Launch

> Note: **HydraFlow** (this project — a new **pump** product **line launch** at Rockford) is
> distinct from **[HydraForce](hydraforce-capacity-expansion.md)** (a **capacity expansion** of
> the HPU assembly at Greenville). Similar names, different plants and different work.

- **Goal / definition of done:** launch the new **HydraFlow** low-pressure pump line at Rockford
  and ship first production units to customers, including
  [AgriTech Equipment](../people/nathan-cole.md).
- **Owner:** [Terrence Boyd](../people/terrence-boyd.md) (VP Operations); commercial by
  [Gwen Salvato](../people/gwen-salvato.md).
- **Status:** on track to a launch gate in mid-August, **but supply-constrained** (see below).

## The binding constraint (supply chain)
- The line needs **ductile-iron castings** that are effectively **single-sourced** from
  **Cascade Castings**, whose account manager is **[Bob Nguyen](../people/bob-nguyen.md)**.
- Casting lead time is ~**11 weeks** — the gating item for launch. The person to work the supply
  risk is Bob Nguyen (via Terrence). A slip here cascades to
  [AgriTech](../people/nathan-cole.md) deliveries.

## Open items
- Launch-gate sign-off owed from Ray — see [commitments](../commitments.md).
- Close the casting capacity-reservation agreement with Cascade to de-risk the launch.
